lesson.uz:
Bu bo‘limda raqamlar, bo‘luvchilar va ketma-ketliklar bilan ishlaysiz. Avval While, If, div va mod mavzularini takrorlang. Har bir Input alohida qatorni o‘qiydi; faqat talab qilingan sonni chiqaring.
Raqamlar: 407 mod 10 = 7, 407 div 10 = 40. Har aylanish sonni kichraytiradi. n=0 holatini alohida tekshiring.
Evklid algoritmi: (48,18) → (18,12) → (12,6) → (6,0). Oxirgi noldan farqli qiymat EKUB = 6. EKUK = (48 div 6)*18 = 144.
Tub sonlarda 0 va 1 tub emas. Kvadrat ildizgacha tekshiring: i*i <= n. Faktorial uchun ko‘paytma 1 dan boshlanadi. Fibonacci uchun eski qiymatlarni yo‘qotmasdan yangilang.
lesson.en:
Practice digits, divisors and sequences. Review While, If, div and mod first. Each Input reads a separate line; print only the requested number.
Digits: 407 mod 10 = 7 and 407 div 10 = 40. Each iteration makes the number smaller. Check n=0 separately.
Euclid: (48,18) → (18,12) → (12,6) → (6,0). The last nonzero value is GCD = 6. LCM = (48 div 6)*18 = 144.
Zero and one are not prime. Test up to the square root with i*i <= n. Start factorial products at 1. Update Fibonacci values without losing the previous pair.
